edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both occurrences state that there were four people on board the missing plane. The NEW occurrence provides the names and ages of these four family members, which matches the count of 'four family members' in the EXISTING occurrence. The sources are independent (CBS News reporting a family member's account vs Associated Press reporting Coast Guard/Bahamas authorities).

spans.value: Bahamian officials contacted the U.S. Coast Guard at about 2 p.m. and requested assistance finding a downed plane

edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both quotes are identical and attribute the information to a spokesperson (likely the same US Coast Guard spokesperson), reporting the same event and time. CBS News often carries AP wire stories.

edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “A small plane carrying four family members flying back home to Florida went missing off the Bahamas on Monday, the U.S. Coast Guard and authorities in the Bahamas said.”; on the same day, CBS News reported “A family member told the Miami Herald the people on board were pilot Mario Lamar, 80, his wife, Lili Lamar, 79, and two of their grandchildren, 28-year-old Sofia Sosa and 22-year-old Christian Sosa.”.

On 2026-09-08, Associated Press reported “Bahamian officials contacted the U.S. Coast Guard at about 2 p.m. and requested assistance finding a downed plane, a spokesperson said.”; on the same day, CBS News reported “Bahamian officials contacted the U.S. Coast Guard at about 2 p.m. and requested assistance finding a downed plane, a spokesperson said.”.
